create_GPTSw3Tokenizer: create a GPTSw3 tokenizer from a SentencePiece vocab file for Swedish text tokenization
build_preprocess_text: build text preprocessing that removes non-printing characters, normalizes whitespaces, and applies NFC Unicode normalization
test_tokenize: test the _tokenize method that preprocesses text and encodes it into SentencePiece tokens
review_convert_tokens_to_string: review the convert_tokens_to_string method that decodes a sequence of tokens back to a single string
run_encode_fast: run fast encoding of text or batch of texts to token ids using the raw SentencePiece model
